title: Iron Archive sighting record
description: One append-only file per sighting, under data/sightings/<machine_id>/<id>.yml. A dated historical observation that a machine was seen at a place; never a present-tense claim (no condition field). References machine and place by immutable id. See CLAUDE.md and docs/model.md.

machine_id.description: Nameplate this was seen at (immutable id). The Action also checks it matches the containing directory.

generation_id.description: Optional. Absent = unsorted (reporter didn't know the generation).

place_name.description: Denormalized copy of the gym name, so the PR diff is human-readable and the sighting survives a lost gym file. Authoritative name lives in the gym record.
